import re

filepath = "/root/autodl-tmp/pacs/analyze_n500_unified.py"
with open(filepath, "r") as f:
    code = f.read()

# ============================================================
# 1. Update docstring: add D063/D064 constraints
# ============================================================
old_constraints = """Constraints:
  D054: median only, no mean
  D059: d_z within-importance only; imp-vs-rand gets Wilcoxon + median_diff"""

new_constraints = """Constraints:
  D054: median only, no mean
  D059: d_z within-importance only; imp-vs-rand gets Wilcoxon + median_diff
  D063: random conditions report values + significance, no FAIL/PASS
  D064: d_z auxiliary with reliability flag; rank-biserial correlation added"""

code = code.replace(old_constraints, new_constraints)

# ============================================================
# 2. Add new helper functions after interpret_d()
# ============================================================
after_interpret_d = '''def interpret_d(d: float) -> str:
    ad = abs(d)
    if ad < 0.2:
        return "negligible"
    elif ad < 0.5:
        return "small"
    elif ad < 0.8:
        return "medium"
    return "large"'''

new_helpers = after_interpret_d + '''


def sig_stars(p: float) -> str:
    if p < 0.001:
        return "***"
    if p < 0.01:
        return "**"
    if p < 0.05:
        return "*"
    return "ns"


def matched_pairs_rank_biserial(diffs: np.ndarray) -> float:
    nonzero = diffs[diffs != 0]
    n = len(nonzero)
    if n < 2:
        return float("nan")
    ranks = stats.rankdata(np.abs(nonzero))
    w_plus = float(np.sum(ranks[nonzero > 0]))
    w_minus = float(np.sum(ranks[nonzero < 0]))
    denom = n * (n + 1) / 2.0
    return float((w_plus - w_minus) / denom)


def dz_is_reliable(dz_ci: list, slabel_a: str, slabel_b: str) -> bool:
    ci_lo, ci_hi = dz_ci
    if any(np.isnan(x) for x in [ci_lo, ci_hi]):
        return False
    ci_width = ci_hi - ci_lo
    if ci_width > 0.5:
        return False
    high_sparsity = slabel_a in ("s025", "s030") or slabel_b in ("s025", "s030")
    if high_sparsity:
        mid = (ci_lo + ci_hi) / 2.0
        upper = ci_hi - mid
        lower = mid - ci_lo
        if lower > 0 and upper / lower > 3.0:
            return False
        if upper > 0 and lower / upper > 3.0:
            return False
    return True'''

code = code.replace(after_interpret_d, new_helpers)

# ============================================================
# 3. Add sig_stars to analyze_condition output
# ============================================================
old_condition_return = """    return {
        "n_valid": n_valid,
        "median_ii_diff": med,
        "median_ii_diff_ci": [ci_lo, ci_hi],
        "ci_excludes_zero": not crosses_zero,
        "wilcoxon_stat": float(wilcoxon_stat),
        "wilcoxon_p": float(wilcoxon_p),
        "per_phase_median": per_phase,
        "midphase_null": null_info,
    }"""

new_condition_return = """    p_val = float(wilcoxon_p)
    return {
        "n_valid": n_valid,
        "median_ii_diff": med,
        "median_ii_diff_ci": [ci_lo, ci_hi],
        "ci_excludes_zero": not crosses_zero,
        "significance": sig_stars(p_val),
        "wilcoxon_stat": float(wilcoxon_stat),
        "wilcoxon_p": p_val,
        "per_phase_median": per_phase,
        "midphase_null": null_info,
    }"""

code = code.replace(old_condition_return, new_condition_return)

# ============================================================
# 4. Add dz_reliable + rank_biserial to within-importance d_z
# ============================================================
old_dz_block = """        dz_importance[pair_key] = {
            "d_z": dz,
            "d_z_ci": list(dz_ci),
            "interpretation": interpret_d(dz),
            "n_paired": n_paired,
            "median_diff": float(np.median(paired_diffs)),
            "wilcoxon_stat": float(w_stat),
            "wilcoxon_p": float(w_p),
        }"""

new_dz_block = """        dz_ci_list = list(dz_ci)
        r_rb = matched_pairs_rank_biserial(paired_diffs)
        dz_importance[pair_key] = {
            "d_z": dz,
            "d_z_ci": dz_ci_list,
            "dz_reliable": dz_is_reliable(dz_ci_list, sl_a, sl_b),
            "interpretation": interpret_d(dz),
            "rank_biserial_r": r_rb,
            "n_paired": n_paired,
            "median_diff": float(np.median(paired_diffs)),
            "wilcoxon_stat": float(w_stat),
            "wilcoxon_p": float(w_p),
        }"""

code = code.replace(old_dz_block, new_dz_block)

# ============================================================
# 5. Add rank_biserial to imp_vs_rand
# ============================================================
old_ivr = """        imp_vs_rand[sl] = {
            "median_diff": float(np.median(paired_diffs)),
            "wilcoxon_stat": float(w_stat),
            "wilcoxon_p": float(w_p),
            "n_paired": n_paired,
        }

    # 5. Permutation monotonicity test"""

new_ivr = """        r_rb_ivr = matched_pairs_rank_biserial(paired_diffs)
        imp_vs_rand[sl] = {
